source_text: Opto equidem, dilectissimi fratres, et consulo pariter et suadeo, ut si fieri potest nemo de fratribus pereat et consentientis populi corpus unum gremio suo gaudens mater includat. si tamen quosdam schismatum duces et dissensionis auctores in caeca et obstinata dementia permanentes non potuerit ad salutis uiam consilium salubre reuocare, ceteri tamen uel simplicitate capti uel errore inducti uel aliqua fallentis astutiae calliditate decepti a fallaciae uos laqueis soluite, uagantes gressus ab erroribus liberate, iter rectum uiae caelestis adgnoscite. contestantis apostoli uox est: praecipimus uobis in nomine Domini Iesu Christi ut recedatis ab omnibus fratribus ambulantibus inordinate et non secundum traditionem quam acceperunt a nobis. et iterum dicit: nemo uos decipiat inanibus uerbis: propterea enim uenit ira Dei super filios contumaciae. nolite ergo esse participes eorum. recedendum est a delinquentibus uel immo fugiendum, ne dum quis male ambulantibus iungitur et per itinera erroris et criminis graditur, a uia ueri itineris exerrans pari crimine et ipse teneatur. unus Deus est et Christus unus et una ecclesia eius et fides una et plebs una in solidam corporis unitatem concordiae glutino copulata. scindi unitas non potest nec corpus unum discidio conpaginis separari, diuulsis laceratione uisceribus in frusta discerpi. quicquid a matrice discesserit . seorsum uiuere et spirare non poterit, substantiam salutis amittit.
thought_title: Exhortation to separate from schismatics and hold to the one Church
orientation: Cyprian, having praised the faithful confessors, now urges the whole people to withdraw from the leaders of schism and to recognize that the Church's unity cannot be divided without loss of salvation.
pass_a_gloss: I wish indeed, most beloved brothers, and I counsel equally and I urge, that if it can happen no one of the brothers should perish and the mother, rejoicing, should enclose in her bosom the one body of the agreeing people. If however she will not have been able to recall to the way of salvation by sound counsel certain leaders of schisms and authors of dissension remaining in blind and obstinate madness, nevertheless the rest, whether captured by simplicity or led in by error or deceived by some cunning of deceiving cleverness, free yourselves from the snares of deceit, free your wandering steps from errors, recognize the straight road of the heavenly way. The voice of the apostle is testifying: we command you in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ that you withdraw from all brothers walking disorderly and not according to the tradition which they received from us. And again he says: let no one deceive you with empty words: for because of this the wrath of God comes upon the sons of stubbornness. Therefore do not be sharers with them. One must withdraw from the delinquent or rather flee, lest while anyone is joined to those walking badly and walks through the paths of error and crime, wandering from the way of the true path he himself be held by equal crime. God is one and Christ is one and his Church is one and faith is one and people is one, joined into the solid unity of the body by the glue of harmony. Unity cannot be split nor can the one body be separated by the tearing apart of its joining, torn apart by the laceration of its inner parts into pieces. Whatever will have departed from the mother will not be able to live and breathe apart, it loses the substance of salvation.

choices.english: the one body of the agreeing people
choices.why: Keeps the literal force of 'consentientis' as agreeing/being of one mind, and 'corpus unum' as one body, preserving the physical metaphor of the mother enclosing it.
rejected: the one body of the consenting people
the single body of a people in agreement

choices.english: the mother, rejoicing, should enclose in her bosom
choices.why: Renders 'gremio' as bosom to keep the maternal image of the Church as mother, and 'gaudens' as rejoicing to preserve the participial force.
rejected: the rejoicing mother should embrace in her lap
the mother should hold in her joyful embrace

choices.why: Literal rendering of both adjectives; 'dementia' as madness keeps the strong negative force Cyprian uses for schismatics.
Keeps the passive participle 'capti' literally, showing that the simple are taken in without full agency.

choices.english: joined into the solid unity of the body by the glue of harmony
choices.why: Renders 'glutino' as glue to preserve the vivid physical metaphor, and 'copulata' as joined; 'concordiae' as harmony per the glossary.
rejected: bound together by the cement of concord
united by the bond of agreement

choices.english: it loses the substance of salvation
choices.why: Keeps 'substantiam' literally as substance, preserving the concrete sense of the essential reality of salvation being lost.
rejected: it forfeits the essence of salvation
it loses the very ground of salvation

pass_b_english: I wish, dearly beloved brothers, and I counsel and urge you as well, that if it can be done, none of the brothers should perish, and that the mother, rejoicing, should enclose the one body of the agreeing people in her bosom. But if the saving counsel cannot recall certain leaders of schisms and authors of division who persist in blind and obstinate madness to the way of salvation, then the rest of you—whether captured by simplicity, led astray by error, or deceived by the cunning of some fraudulent cleverness—free yourselves from the snares of deceit, free your wandering steps from error, and recognize the straight road of the heavenly way.

The voice of the apostle is a solemn warning: “We command you in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ to withdraw from all brothers who walk disorderly and not according to the tradition they received from us” (2 Thessalonians 3:6). And again he says: “Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience. Therefore do not be partakers with them” (Ephesians 5:6–7).

We must withdraw from those who sin—or rather, we must flee from them—so that no one who joins himself to those who walk badly and travels along the paths of error and crime may wander from the way of the true path and be held guilty of the same crime himself. There is one God and one Christ and one Church of his and one faith and one people joined into the solid unity of the body by the glue of harmony. Unity cannot be split, nor can one body be separated by the breaking of its structure, torn apart into pieces by the laceration of its organs. Whatever has departed from the mother will not be able to live and breathe on its own; it loses the substance of salvation.

last_rejected.quote: The voice of the apostle is a solemn warning
last_rejected.why: contestantis means 'protesting/witnessing', not 'solemn warning'; changes apostolic voice's character
last_rejected.fix: This is the voice of the apostle protesting:
last_rejected.ruling: contestantis = 'protesting/witnessing'; 'solemn warning' conveys the sense adequately within range

last_rejected.why: fallentis astutiae = 'deceiving craftiness', not 'fraudulent cleverness'; astutia is craftiness, not cleverness
last_rejected.ruling: fallentis astutiae = 'deceiving craftiness'; 'fraudulent cleverness' is within normal semantic range

last_rejected.fix: the tearing apart of its joints
last_rejected.ruling: conpago = 'structure/joint'; 'structure' is valid; discidio as 'breaking' is acceptable

last_rejected.why: uisceribus = 'inner parts/entrails', metaphorically 'vitals/heart'; 'organs' is too modern/anatomical
last_rejected.ruling: uisceribus = 'inner parts/entrails'; 'organs' is a legitimate classical meaning, not too modern
